_comment: Singer Tap Validator - config file (pass via --config <file>)
_tap_config_comment: Path to tap_credentials.json — enables LIVE discovery + sync execution. Omit for static-only analysis.
_venv_comment: Optional: path to the virtualenv that has the tap installed. Auto-detected if omitted.
_output_dir_comment: Where runtime artifacts are written (catalog.json, sync output, state). Defaults to <tap_dir>/validator_output/
_timeout_comment: Max seconds for a single tap subprocess (discovery or sync). Default 600.
